`Dynamo` tables' ARNs in links, a VPC for `WebFunction`, and fixes for saving the state, site builds, container image functions, large `StaticSite` deploys and `sst dev`'s memory. Still built on upstream [v4.17.2](https://github.com/anomalyco/sst/releases/tag/v4.17.2).

Thanks to [@AlperSakarya](https://github.com/AlperSakarya), who sent ten of the pull requests below, most of them carrying fixes from SST's repository, and to [@insd47](https://github.com/insd47), who sent the `SST_STAGE` fix. The authors of the SST pull requests they carry, and the people who reported the problems, are named with each one.

### New

- **A function linked to an `sst.aws.Dynamo` table can read its ARN,** as `Resource.MyTable.arn`, including for a table referenced with `Dynamo.get()`. ([#251](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/251), by [@AlperSakarya](https://github.com/AlperSakarya), carrying [anomalyco/sst#7044](https://github.com/anomalyco/sst/pull/7044) by [@AliAladraj](https://github.com/AliAladraj); [anomalyco/sst#7000](https://github.com/anomalyco/sst/issues/7000), reported by [@mss-dieliko](https://github.com/mss-dieliko))
- **`sst.aws.WebFunction` takes a `vpc`,** so its server's outbound traffic goes through the VPC's private subnets and can reach private resources, such as a database. With `vpc`, the deploy creates a Lambda network connector, which takes a few minutes, and a deploy role with limited permissions needs `lambda:PassNetworkConnector`, and `iam:PassRole` on the connector's operator role. Without `vpc`, nothing changes. ([#236](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/236))

### Fixes

- **A state write that Cloudflare or S3 asks to retry is sent again whole.** With `home: "cloudflare"`, a write that Cloudflare rate limited or failed was retried with an empty body, so R2 could store the stage's state as an empty object, with no error. With `state.compress` on AWS, a write that S3 asked to retry failed with `request stream is not seekable`. ([#257](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/257))
- **Site builds no longer store their environment, including the CLI's AWS credentials, in plain text in the state.** The `<name>Builder` command's environment is now a Pulumi secret, and `sst diff` shows it as `[secret]`. The build gets the same variables as before. A stage's earlier state versions still have it, so if the CLI's credentials there were long-lived keys rather than a session's, rotate them. ([#242](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/242), by [@AlperSakarya](https://github.com/AlperSakarya); [anomalyco/sst#6996](https://github.com/anomalyco/sst/issues/6996), reported by [@jsve](https://github.com/jsve))
- **Container image functions no longer overwrite each other's image.** Each one's image is pushed to the bootstrap ECR repository under a tag named after its component, instead of all of them using `latest`. ([#256](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/256), by [@AlperSakarya](https://github.com/AlperSakarya), carrying [anomalyco/sst#6004](https://github.com/anomalyco/sst/pull/6004) by [@doron98](https://github.com/doron98))
- **`StaticSite` deploys no longer run out of memory on large sites.** The files are read and hashed one at a time instead of all at once. ([#240](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/240), by [@AlperSakarya](https://github.com/AlperSakarya); [anomalyco/sst#7023](https://github.com/anomalyco/sst/issues/7023), reported by [@zemeja](https://github.com/zemeja))
- **`sst dev` no longer grows in memory without bound in a long session.** It keeps the most recent 1,000 function calls, and about 64 MB of their inputs, outputs and logs, and drops older ones, so a tool connected to its socket gets the recent calls rather than every call since it started. ([#238](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/238), by [@AlperSakarya](https://github.com/AlperSakarya); [anomalyco/sst#7049](https://github.com/anomalyco/sst/issues/7049), reported by [@julian-adesio](https://github.com/julian-adesio))
- **`SST_STAGE` is set for every command, not only `sst dev`.** Builds and scripts that run during `sst deploy`, `sst diff`, `sst remove` and the other commands can read the stage from the environment, as they already could under `sst dev`. The config's `app()` still doesn't see it. ([#252](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/252), by [@insd47](https://github.com/insd47))
- **`sst remove` no longer deletes a bucket's public access block before the bucket.** The block stays until the bucket is deleted, and a bucket kept with `removal: "retain"` keeps its block, so GuardDuty doesn't raise `Policy:S3/BucketBlockPublicAccessDisabled`. ([#223](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/223), by [@AlperSakarya](https://github.com/AlperSakarya), carrying [anomalyco/sst#7048](https://github.com/anomalyco/sst/pull/7048) by [@mikkopori](https://github.com/mikkopori))
- **An import whose inputs don't match shows the value SST tried to set beside the one that's there,** for an object or a list, and points to the Pulumi log. ([#255](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/255), by [@AlperSakarya](https://github.com/AlperSakarya), carrying [anomalyco/sst#6298](https://github.com/anomalyco/sst/pull/6298) by [@Ayush2k02](https://github.com/Ayush2k02); [anomalyco/sst#6285](https://github.com/anomalyco/sst/issues/6285), reported by [@ekasprzyk](https://github.com/ekasprzyk))

### Also

- Two cleanups in the CLI: an unreachable error check after the HTTPS server starts, and a redundant zero buffer size on plugin channels ([#250](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/250), [#249](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/249), by [@AlperSakarya](https://github.com/AlperSakarya), carrying [anomalyco/sst#7007](https://github.com/anomalyco/sst/pull/7007) and [anomalyco/sst#7003](https://github.com/anomalyco/sst/pull/7003) by [@iliya-vidrush](https://github.com/iliya-vidrush)).
- The automatic review of pull requests picks its free model by the size of the diff, and uses a paid model only when no free one wrote a review ([#245](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/245), by [@AlperSakarya](https://github.com/AlperSakarya)).

### Install

```bash
npm install sst@npm:@sst-community/sst@4.25.0
```

To switch an existing project:

1. Check that `node --version` shows `v22` or later, wherever you run `sst`, CI included.
2. Set its dependency to `"sst": "npm:@sst-community/sst@4.25.0"` and reinstall.

For a project that isn't JavaScript, install the CLI globally. It still needs Node.js 22 or later, to run `sst.config.ts`:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sst-community/sst/main/install | bash
```
